title: DAgger twins, training seeds 4 to 6, on validation links at the chosen iterations, 11 policies
description: Training seeds 4 to 6 of the DAgger twins (exp-net2-r25b-v9-259: net2 on net1 v9's means; exp-neto2-r26b-v2-260: neto2 on neto1 v2 with the rule at u = 0.25 or 0.375 as teacher), at the iterations chosen for seeds 1 to 3 in exp-dagger-twins-iter-val-256 (net2 after 19, neto2 after 39 at u = 0.25 and after 59 at u = 0.375), nothing re-chosen; policies from model-dagger-twins-s456, beside BBRv3 and both rules as reference lines. Validation links at campaign seed 21, as for seeds 1 to 3 in release 256.
prepare: N9="$IN/v9/$(cat "$IN/v9/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; N2="$IN/v2/$(cat "$IN/v2/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v9" "$N9" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v2" "$N2" --u 0.375; P=(--policy "rule-v9=$OUT/v9/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v2=$OUT/v2/rule-u0.375.onnx"); (cd "$IN/y" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); for f in "$IN"/y/ppo-r25-means-s*-i19.onnx "$IN"/y/ppo-r26-u0.25-s*-i39.onnx "$IN"/y/ppo-r26-u0.375-s*-i59.onnx; do n="$(basename "$f" .onnx)"; n="${n#ppo-}"; it="${n##*-}"; b="${n%-*}"; P+=(--policy "${b%-*}-$it-${b##*-}=$f"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 22 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" rule-v9
